basic_info.description: Experience the epitome of luxury living with this stunning corner home at The Infinity!  With approximately 1,335 square foot (tax records) of spacious living, this 2-bedroom, 2 bathroom gem boasts an open plan kitchen with premium finishes and a curved living room that showcases exciting architecture.  Enjoy ample storage - including a walk-in, primary closet - and a convenient office nook, making this home the perfect blend of style and functionality.  The north-east exposure of this corner floor plan provides abundant natural light and verdant tree-top views.  One car parking, 24x7 door staff and security, 5,000sqft fitness center, heated indoor pool, movie screening room, club lounge for entertaining, conference rooms, and business center make this the ideal SF home!
